lines.1: I didn't have anything in particular I wanted to do.
lines.2: I joined on a whim, thinking this might at least give me some memories of school life.
lines.4: The haughty, selfish student council president: Erika Kiriya.
lines.5: My older cousin, a samurai girl obsessed with discipline: Otome Kurogane.
lines.6: My childhood friend and partner in crime: Kinu Kanisawa.
lines.7: The lone wolf who always goes her own way: Nagomi Yashi.
lines.8: The spacey yet forceful teacher: Inori Oeyama.
lines.9: What a terrifying lineup. It was practically a dictatorship of empresses.
lines.10: Every last one of them was a strong-willed girl.
lines.11: Were Yoshimi and I the only normal ones here?
lines.13: Whenever I got tired, I could count on her to soothe me...
lines.14: Still, with this particular student council lineup...
lines.15: I remembered what Subaru had said.
lines.16: 「Good for you, man. This executive committee is a harem.」
lines.17: 「You might even find yourself a girlfriend in there, right?」
